title: Norm's Memory Sale
description: Norm Magnusson tells the fictional-ish stories behind the objects in his Memory Sale, with musical interludes, during the exhibition The Narrative of Things.
imageAlt: Norm Magnusson performing Norm's Memory Sale
about: Norm Magnusson regales the audience with tales of the objects in his Memory Sale, part of the exhibition The Narrative of Things. The delightful narratives tied to the objects make you think about the memories you have tied to all of your own things: stories with musical interludes.

The first performance, with improv guitar by Peter Dougan, was planned for March 12 and moved to March 19 because of the weather. Because of high demand, a second performance followed on April 2 with music by Steve Mosto. Both started at 6 pm, with a $10 suggested donation for the performers.
